grant.title: Approve this Router + Fusion run?
grant.body: This turn reserves up to {cap}, but your cost budget only has {available} left. Approve a one-time grant of {shortfall} for this run only.

breakerToast.title: Router + Fusion paused for {surface}
breakerToast.body: Repeated failures ({reason}). Turns use the original path and are not ledgered until you re-arm it in Settings → AI connections → Routing.

refusal.ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: This call already used every transport attempt it was allowed.
refusal.BUDGET_FROZEN: The run spent past its cap and was stopped.
refusal.CALL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: A model call's outcome is unknown, so the run stopped rather than pay for it twice.
refusal.CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The conversation is too long to compact within this run's cap.
refusal.CONTEXT_PRECHECK_FAILED: The conversation does not fit in the context window of the models this run needs.
refusal.DATA_CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED: The model is not allowed to receive this workspace's data class.
refusal.DECLINED_GRANT: The one-time budget grant was declined, so the turn did not run.
refusal.DEPLOYMENT_NOT_IN_SNAPSHOT: The strict budget does not allow a model outside this run's route.
refusal.DISPATCH_FAILED: The turn could not be sent to the model.
refusal.FORMAT_INVALID: The model's answer was not in the required format.
refusal.FUSION_INSUFFICIENT_CANDIDATES: Too few panel answers survived to compare.
refusal.FUSION_TEXT_ONLY: Cascade and panel runs read text only. Remove the images or switch this conversation to Direct.
refusal.INTERNAL: Router + Fusion hit an internal error.
refusal.JUDGE_OUTPUT_INVALID: The judge's report could not be read.
refusal.MAX_MODEL_CALLS: The run reached its model-call limit.
refusal.PII_BLOCKED: This conversation contains personal data or a secret (an email address, an ID number or a key), so it was not sent to the cascade or panel models.
refusal.PRICE_UNKNOWN: The strict budget does not allow a model without an audited price.
refusal.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The provider was switched off or lost its credentials during the turn.
refusal.RESERVATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The reservation for this call was already settled or released.
refusal.RESTRICTED_NOT_GRANTED: Restricted data may not be sent to this provider.
refusal.REVOKED: Access to this model was revoked during the turn.
refusal.ROUTER_FUSION_DISABLED: Router + Fusion for chat was switched off during the turn.
refusal.ROUTER_FUSION_UNAVAILABLE: Router + Fusion is unavailable right now, so this cascade or panel turn did not run.
refusal.ROUTE_EXPIRED: The route chosen for this message expired before it was sent. Send it again.
refusal.ROUTE_NO_SOLUTION: No model fits this turn's budget, limits and data rules.
refusal.RUN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The next call would exceed this run's cap.
refusal.RUN_BUSY: Another window is already working on this run.
refusal.RUN_EXISTS: A run with this id already exists.
refusal.RUN_INPUT_MISSING: The run's input could not be found.
refusal.RUN_LOST: The window running this turn closed before it finished.
refusal.RUN_NOT_FOUND: The run could not be found.
refusal.RUN_NOT_RUNNING: The run had already ended when the model call was requested.
refusal.RUN_SETUP_FAILED: The run could not be started.
refusal.RUN_TERMINAL: The run had already ended, so no further calls can be reserved.
refusal.SESSION_BUSY: Another Router + Fusion turn is still running in this conversation.
refusal.SESSION_CLOSED: The conversation closed before the call could be approved.
refusal.SESSION_VERSION_CONFLICT: The conversation changed while the run was starting.
refusal.STAGE_NOT_HELD: The budget held for this stage was already used or released.
refusal.STEP_ALREADY_COMMITTED: This step already completed, so it was not sent to the model again.
refusal.STEP_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: A step's outcome is unknown after an interruption, so it was not run again.
refusal.TENANT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Your cost budget cannot cover this run's cap.
refusal.TOOL_CALL_LIMIT: The run reached its limit of evidence lookups.
refusal.TOOL_ROUND_EXCEEDED: A panel member asked for evidence more times than it is allowed.
refusal.VERIFICATION_INCONCLUSIVE: The answer could not be verified.

runCard.label: Router + Fusion
runCard.bypassed: Router + Fusion was unavailable ({code}), so this turn used the original path and was not ledgered.
runCard.bypassedTripped: Router + Fusion was unavailable ({code}) and is now paused for chat. Turns use the original path until you re-arm it in Settings.

costStatus.pending: pending — a call is still unanswered

runCard.estimatedCap: Estimated cap: this model has no audited price, so the run may overspend its cap.
runCard.acceptanceSchemaOnly: {profile} (schema only — the answer's content was not verified)

fusion.modeCascade: Cascade: a cheap draft, escalated if it fails verification
fusion.modePanel: Panel: independent answers compared by a judge
fusion.candidatesValue: {members, plural, =1 {# answer} other {# answers}}, {rejected} rejected, {evidence} with invalid evidence
fusion.judgeValue: {supported, plural, =1 {# claim} other {# claims}} supported, {rejected} rejected, {unverified} without evidence

qualityValue.degraded: Degraded: fewer checks than the action asks for

reason.FORMAT_INVALID: The draft was not in the required format
reason.VERIFICATION_INCONCLUSIVE: The draft could not be verified

settings.title: Router + Fusion
settings.desc: Budget-capped, ledgered routing. Off by default: while it is off, routing works exactly as it did before.
settings.masterDesc: The master switch. Nothing is routed differently until a surface below is also on.
settings.surfacesDesc: Each surface is switched on on its own and can be switched off alone if it misbehaves.
settings.surfaceNeedsMaster: Turn on the master switch first.
settings.laterReleaseDesc: Not available in this version. The switch has no effect.

chat.label: Chat
chat.desc: Chat turns in the desktop app run as direct runs: capped, ledgered, rerouted only visibly, and refused rather than silently downgraded.

gatewayRuns.label: Gateway runs
gatewayRuns.desc: The /v1/runs API and the cognia/* virtual models.

gatewayPassthroughLedger.label: Gateway passthrough ledger
gatewayPassthroughLedger.desc: Ledger every model call proxied by the local gateway.

agentsWorkflows.label: Agents and workflows
agentsWorkflows.desc: Model calls made by agents, Squads and workflows.

utilityLedger.label: Background generations
utilityLedger.desc: Titles, memory, judges and other background model calls.

companion.label: Web and mobile
companion.desc: Runs started from paired web and mobile devices.

breaker.tripped: Paused after repeated failures ({reason}) since {when}. Turns use the original path and are not ledgered.
breaker.thresholdDesc: Consecutive infrastructure failures after which a surface falls back to the original path until you re-arm it.

budget.trackedDesc: Every call is reserved and settled. A model without an audited price is held at a conservative estimate and may overspend it.
budget.strictDesc: Only models with an audited price and per-call accounting may run; any other model is refused.
budget.directCapDesc: A turn is refused rather than exceed this cap.
budget.unknownReserve: Hold per call without a price (USD)
budget.unknownReserveDesc: In tracked mode, each call to a model without an audited price reserves this much.
budget.invalidAmount: Enter a dollar amount with at most six decimal places.
budget.cascadeCapDesc: A cascade is refused rather than exceed this cap.
budget.panelCapDesc: A panel is refused rather than exceed this cap.

dataClass.label: Default data class
dataClass.desc: Work is treated as this class unless its workspace or conversation raises it. It is never lowered automatically.
dataClass.grantsDesc: Local models may always receive restricted data; aggregators without a provable destination never may.

rules.title: Auto rules
rules.desc: Without evaluation data, Auto uses the baseline action. Approve a rule to let Auto pick another action when the turn matches it.

economy_simple.label: Economy model for simple text work
economy_simple.desc: Transform and extract tasks with low or medium ambiguity use the economy action.

cascade_verifiable.label: Cascade for verifiable output
cascade_verifiable.desc: Requests that must match a JSON schema — through the Run API or the cognia/auto model — start on a cheap model and escalate if the check fails. A chat turn runs as a cascade only when you pick Cascade.

panel_research.label: Panel for research synthesis
panel_research.desc: Research synthesis runs independent answers and a judge that checks them against evidence. Text only: the turn runs without agent tools.

delegate_multifile.label: Delegate for multi-file code changes
delegate_multifile.desc: Multi-file implementation runs in a sandbox with acceptance checks.

migration.notice: Your Auto routing was carried over: the economy rule is approved and your per-request cost limit became the chat run cap.
migration.restoreDesc: Switch Router + Fusion off and put Auto back exactly as it was before you enabled it.
migration.restored: Legacy Auto restored and Router + Fusion switched off.

settings.saveFailed: Could not save the Router + Fusion settings.

actions.title: Actions
actions.desc: What each mode runs: the model alias behind every role, how the answer is checked, and the run cap. Every change gives the action a new configuration hash; a run keeps the hash it ran under.
actions.delegateDormant: Delegate runs need a sandbox and acceptance checks, which arrive in a later release. This action is never chosen.
actions.rolesDesc: Each role runs on a model alias from Routing → Model mappings. A panel needs different model revisions for its members.

profileDesc.text_basic: The answer is checked for format only; its content is not verified.
profileDesc.text_review: A reviewer model checks the answer against the request.
profileDesc.schema_fixture: The answer must match the requested JSON schema.
profileDesc.evidence_review: Every claim must be backed by evidence the judge can check.

actions.profileDormant: Needs a runtime verifier, which arrives in a later release; the router does not choose this action until then.
actions.runCapDesc: Leave empty to use the {mode} cap of ${cap}.
actions.panelSizeDesc: Three members need the Panel member C role.
actions.webToolsDesc: Panel members may search and read the web for evidence.

issue.ID_INVALID: Use 3–48 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.
issue.ID_TAKEN: An action with this id already exists.
issue.MODE_NOT_EDITABLE: This mode cannot be used yet.
issue.ROLE_MISSING: The {role} role needs a model alias.
issue.ROLE_UNKNOWN: {role} is not a role of this mode.
issue.ALIAS_EMPTY: The {role} role needs a model alias.
issue.PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED: This check is not available for this mode.
issue.CAP_INVALID: Enter a dollar amount with at most six decimal places.
issue.PANEL_C_REQUIRED: A panel of three needs the Panel member C role.
issue.LIMIT_INVALID: A panel has two or three members.

add.title: Add an action
add.idDesc: 3–48 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. The new action starts from the built-in action of its mode.

progress.buffered: The answer appears once it is verified.
progress.calls: {count, plural, =1 {# model call} other {# model calls}}

modePicker.title: How this conversation's turns run
modePicker.autoDesc: Direct, unless a cascade or panel rule you approved matches the turn.
modePicker.directDesc: One model answers and streams as it writes, with the agent's tools.
modePicker.cascadeDesc: A cheap model drafts, the draft is checked, and a strong model takes over if it fails. Text only, no agent tools.
modePicker.panelDesc: Independent models answer, a judge compares them against evidence, and one answer is written. Text only, no agent tools.
modePicker.buffered: Cascade and panel answers appear once they are verified.
modePicker.paused: Router + Fusion is paused for chat after repeated failures. Cascade and Panel turns are refused until you re-arm it in Settings → AI connections → Routing.
